title: Products of exact prime-race crossing heights
description:
At the exact amplitude 1.9735, the 62 crossing heights through one million and the eleven primes through 31 have no nontrivial product relation with exponents bounded by 90,000. Two opposite-sign crossing pairs have transcendental geometric midpoints. The proof determines the generic multiplicative rank and gives an arithmetic alternative for every fixed positive magnitude through 5.85.

Proof and hypotheses.
